scope: Builder live boot only; not an installation speed measurement or candidate installed-boot validation

request.command:
set -e
printf 'preflight mode: '; cat /run/omarchy-benchmark/preflight-complete
printf 'root filesystem: '; findmnt -no FSTYPE /
printf 'live root permissions: '; stat -c '%a' /root
printf 'original root permissions: '; stat -c '%a' /run/archiso/airootfs/root
[[ $(stat -c '%a' /root) == $(stat -c '%a' /run/archiso/airootfs/root) ]]
cmp /root/.automated_script.benchmark-original.sh /run/archiso/airootfs/root/.automated_script.sh
printf 'original entrypoint checksum: '; sha256sum /root/.automated_script.benchmark-original.sh
printf 'payload manifest: '; cat /usr/local/lib/omarchy-benchmark/manifest.json
printf 'preflight log: '; cat /var/log/omarchy-benchmark-preflight.log
printf 'SSH status: '; systemctl is-active sshd
printf 'kernel command line: '; cat /proc/cmdline
printf 'installer processes: '; pgrep -af '^(python|python3) -m orchestrator.main' || true

set -e
[[ $(cat /run/omarchy-benchmark/preflight-complete) == builder ]]
if pgrep -af '^(python|python3) -m orchestrator.main'; then exit 1; fi
python - <<'PYTHON'
import hashlib, json, stat
from pathlib import Path
manifest=json.loads(Path('/usr/local/lib/omarchy-benchmark/manifest.json').read_text())
for member in manifest['payload']:
 path=Path('/')/member['path']
 assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==member['sha256'], path
 assert oct(stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode))==member['mode'], path
print(json.dumps({'payload_files_verified':len(manifest['payload']), 'mode':manifest['mode'], 'original_initramfs_sha256':manifest['original_initramfs_sha256'], 'hook_sha256':manifest['hook_sha256']}))
PYTHON
